rows: Isolate worker execution in disposable micro-VMs, one sandbox per target claim
Removes 592 GB of per-claim worktree debris and all shared-filesystem coupling from the host; scaling to 64 workers becomes a platform quota question
Keep every authority, integration, and evidence contract host-side and unchanged
The dispatch lease, target claims, serial integration, and the knowledge queue already define the boundaries a remote executor needs
Specify sandbox lifecycle in the state contract's own vocabulary
Claims, leases, events, and traces must have one definition; the sandbox binds to them rather than duplicating them
props.title: Goals

rows: Move the agent loop, model access, or knowledge corpora into sandboxes
The worker process on the host keeps the Pi session, codex-lb, graph and corpus tools, and telemetry; relocation is a named deviation, rejected in Execution Boundary
One worker, one claim, one bounded source space holds; only the mechanism that materializes the workspace changes
Build or publish sandbox images in this pass
MANIFEST.md groundwork is staged and on hold; the proof of concept is scoped separately
props.title: Non-goals

steps.text: Worker realization creates a target claim under the run's dispatch lease; the claim's sandbox is created with it
sandbox labels record the claim, lease, and trace identity, so any reconciler can map a live sandbox to the claim that justifies it
The workspace materializes inside the sandbox from the game image plus the claim's base-revision seed (under 10 MB)
Agent turns execute in the sandbox: bash, edits, incremental builds, scoring; the host worker process presents the current lease id on every guarded command
The sandbox stops while the model thinks and wakes on the next tool call; the claim's deadline bounds the whole cycle
a stopped sandbox bills disk only and releases its vCPU quota; workspace state is preserved
Checkpoint evidence returns to the host: runner validation records, the selected patch, facts; serial integration and the epoch boundary proceed unchanged
Claim settlement deletes the sandbox; recovery reaps sandboxes named by cancelled claim ids
